note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase, reported by Push Square 18 Nov 2026). Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, and cite their sources beside each trophy. Where launch-week guides had no confirmed method yet, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI (official site & trailers)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no extra task behind it. Work the roadmap in order and leave the long grinds for last: A Long Road (100% completion) is the final gate for most players, so check your progress under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once the story is done. On Xbox the same 55 goals are achievements worth 1,000 Gamerscore, with no platinum equivalent.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the story, so it unlocks as you start the game and cannot be missed — just follow the opening beats until the mission-complete screen. This is Lucia and Jason's introduction to Leonida, the state Rockstar's trailers set the game in.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes (chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene). Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation — it is the one missable step in the whole list and feeds Positive Mental Attitude. Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until that trophy pops.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. This is the chapter where switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, so most of the list starts opening here — partner trophies, garages and the Scooter Bros app all unlock in this chapter. Make a fresh manual save at the start of the chapter; there is no mission replay, so a chapter-start save is your only way back.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago the moment it appears in this chapter — it carries an hourglass icon and its strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so save first, then race. The Snap Gun jewelry robberies and the three-shops partner robbery also open up here.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Near the end of the chapter, play the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — it unlocks the bank vault robberies behind Maximum Withdrawal and sets up the 4-star escape that also earns Hot Together. Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the only hidden gold trophy and the story's endpoint — everything outside the story, including the side-story finales and the 100% checklist, stays available after the credits, so there is no rush to clean up before it. Keep one untouched manual save from just before it, since there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to its end. Story-mission trophies unlock as you play the missions in order and cannot be missed — the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. If you are hunting the platinum, just keep playing the story; these twelve mission and chapter trophies take care of themselves.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist to its end. Like the other mission trophies it pops on completion and cannot be missed, so there is no special preparation — just reach it in the story order and finish it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play to its end. It pops on the mission-complete screen and cannot be missed. Story missions cannot be replayed, so if you want to rewatch a mission, make a manual save before starting it — the game gives you 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Headliners to its end. It pops on completion and cannot be missed. These mission trophies are the spine of the roadmap: twelve of the 28 hidden trophies are unmissable story trophies that pop as you play.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown to its end. VCIA is Vice City International Airport — the same airport where the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can asks you to steal a jet from a boarding bridge, so you will know the layout by the time you come back for it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory to its end. It pops on the mission-complete screen and cannot be missed. With this, the seven named story-mission trophies are done; the remaining hidden trophies are chapter trophies, side-story finales and free-roam goals.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own checklist, which appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — work you did earlier still counts. The checklist is a 35-task list: expect 300 stunts (not just the 250 for Cunning Stunts), 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models discovered, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 14 drone races and 42 shooting-range golds among the tasks. It is the longest grind in the game and the reason launch guides put the platinum at around 200 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, so mix them as you travel instead of grinding one type. Do not stop at 250: the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going and let this trophy pop on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once — one go at each is enough, you do not need to win or finish them. The activities are the ones the game tracks across Leonida: racing, fishing, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races, meditation, gym training, bowling and hunting-style outings are the set the other trophies point to, so sample each early and this pops while you explore. Check your progress against the other activity trophies in this guide to see which types you have left.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the game's two shooting ranges. Treat each challenge as its own time trial: learn the target pattern first with a slow run, then push for gold, and use the range's own weapon for the challenge rather than your favourite loadout. The medals are a 100% checklist task too, so they count twice toward the platinum.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — one win per location is enough. Fly the racing line rather than the shortest line: the gates reward clean, tight turns, and a crash costs more time than a wide corner. The 14 wins are also a 100% checklist task.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replays of the same race do not count, so work through the race list across Leonida instead of farming one event. Street races, including the Yago strand in Chapter 3, feed this total, so do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago the moment it appears. A fast car you have tuned and a clean first lap matter more than a perfect car.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing opens with the story's first mission, Gone Fishing, so try the challenge as soon as Cal offers it in Chapter 1 — it is a skill check, not a gear check, so watch the line tension and reel in the windows when the fish tires. Do it early while you are in Chapter 1 anyway for the balcony meditation.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to end. Any arcade cabinet counts — pick the game you are best at and play it through rather than sampling them all. It is one of the quickest trophies in the list and a good first checkbox in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline through to its final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, and like the other five side-story finales it stays available after the credits, so there is no deadline — follow the strand's missions whenever they appear and the trophy pops on the last one. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which tracks different questlines.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline through to its final mission. Kenton's finale is one of six side-story finales, and all of them stay open after the story ends, so play the strand at your own pace and the trophy pops when the last mission completes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline through to its final mission. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so do not expect that counter to move — the finale trophy is its own reward. Like the other side-story finales it stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own finale trophies — so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. The time-sensitive one is Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 (hourglass icon): do it the moment it appears, save first, and do not let it expire.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline through to its final mission. Randy's finale is one of the six side-story finales, all of which stay available after the credits. Follow the strand's missions as they appear and the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline through to its final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, and it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — its finale trophy is separate. Like the other side-story finales it stays open after the story, so there is no deadline.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, after Lucia is home — a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time — follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional meditation. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close; each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. Save before every chapter — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. Bret's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks — follow the deck's targets in order. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt grades you on, so take the shot standing still and do not rush it. The strand stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are a Leonida-wide collectible, so pick up every set you pass while doing other trophies instead of hunting them in one sweep — exploration for The Goodtime State and vehicle scanning for Whip It Good take you past the same places. The 3 sets are also a 100% checklist task.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations across Leonida. The same app's vehicle scan counts toward Whip It Good, so make scanning a habit every time you drive: stop, scan the traffic around you, and move on. The 100 locations are a 100% checklist task too.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, tracked under Progress > Challenges. Many complete on their own while you play — stunts, races, robberies and exploration all feed them — so do not grind them first; check the list after the story and mop up the nearest ones. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. The easiest way is a bank vault job: the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4 hands you a 4-star wanted level straight away, so bring your partner, grab the bags together and drive out of the red heat zone — the trophy only pops once you have left the zone, not just the flashing search area. Partner switching opens during Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. The trick is the opposite of a normal escape: if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so keep the heat on between shops and do not hide. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of hunting specific cars — variety comes to you. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming — and Adrenaline extends it, so pop Adrenaline first. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle so one burst can drop each target before Focus ends. Save first if you are trying it mid-mission.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport (VCIA), steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops. Expect heavy police attention the moment you roll out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Each vault job gives you a 4-star wanted level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults, so keep going past five.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run the same routes the bank-vault mission teaches you to tail — follow one, hit it, and get clear of the red heat zone before the trophy checks you: like Hot Together, it only pops once you have left the zone, not just the flashing search area. Bring your partner if the job lets you; the extra hands help with the bags.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Mount Kalaga, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and the Grassrivers are the regions Rockstar's trailers show, and the in-game map tracks each area as you enter it. Drive the highways between story missions and detour into every named place you pass; the map fills in as you go, and the last few areas are usually the small towns off the main roads. Pair it with Whip It Good: scan traffic in each new area.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are the gang-run fronts scattered across Leonida — the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, Kingpin Bowling, is one you visit in Chapter 2, and it shows the pattern: find the valuables inside, grab them and escape the police. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops on the way there.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, the Vice City beachfront. No confirmed method was published at launch — the description itself is the hint: go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. It is one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger yet, and it may pop during normal play; check the linked guides after launch if it does not.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — drive a car straight through the glass, in classic GTA style. No confirmed method was published at launch, so the description is the only hint: pick a showroom, get a fast car inside or lined up at the doors, and drive out through the front. It may pop during normal play; check the linked guides after launch if it does not.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Get Jason and Lucia both to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — the partner trains alongside you, so both characters' Strength climbs together. Partner play opens during Chapter 2, so start the gym habit early and this pops without a separate grind.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind while you work the robbery and combat trophies — Pest Control's 39 operations, the bank vaults and the jewelry stores all push the counter. Just play the game the way the other trophies ask and check the counter in your stats now and then.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something — that is what the description hints at, and no confirmed method was published at launch. It is one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger yet. The honest advice: play normally, retry anything you fail, and it will likely pop on its own; if it does not, check the linked guides after launch rather than guessing at a method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida — the description reads like a random-encounter trophy, and no confirmed method was published at launch. It is one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger yet. Explore off the main roads, visit the odd corners of the map at night, and let it come to you; check the linked guides after launch if it has not popped by the end of the story.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. No confirmed method was published at launch, so the description is the hint: get a car up to speed past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and keep moving. It may pop during normal play; check the linked guides after launch if it does not.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and you clean them by selling them to your contacts — the $250,000 total is cumulative, so every job feeds it. Bank vault robberies are the biggest source, so this trophy tracks Maximum Withdrawal: keep robbing vaults past the five that trophy needs.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, food, ammo, car parts — so it climbs while you play normally. The eight garages for Little Boxes cost about $160,000 on their own, so buy those and this trophy is most of the way there. Do not waste money early; let the story's payouts fund it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count — only the ones you buy. Buy them as soon as you can afford them: you need the garage space to register cars for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (Little Boxes) and register cheap cars you steal off the street.
